previous_design_failure: The former universal representability claim has a short multiplication-by-two counterexample; the separate finite-limit clause is generic and does not turn the counterexample into a sustained classification task.

retained: Countable inverse tower of finite-rank free abelian groups.
added_for_precision: Explicit U in V and U-small abelian groups, representing objects, and diagrams.
not_added: No injectivity or surjectivity of transitions.

changed_target: Replace universal existence plus finite-limit clause by exact representability classification, exact countable-limit classification, and all natural transformations between the resulting record functors.
terminal_result: M_P = colim P_n* is countable torsion-free; F_P = M_P tensor -. Representability, preservation of countable limits, and finite generation of M_P are equivalent. The representing group is M_P*. Natural transformations are exactly homomorphisms between the M invariants.
minimum_acceptable_completion: A non-circular complete representability criterion with necessity, sufficiency, and representing-object uniqueness.
A complete criterion for all countable diagrams and proof that it agrees with representability.
All group-valued natural transformations, identities, and composition.
alternate_routes: Tensor invariant plus countable-product finite-generation test.
Finite-stage retract or pro-constant criterion with a proof equivalent to the invariant.
Applicable projectivity/compactness or finitely presented tensor results, with countability and variance checked.

shortest_valid_completion.route: Identify F with M tensor -, use the countable product of Z to force the countable torsion-free M to be finitely generated, dualize finite free M, and use naturality along Z to A to classify all transformations.
shortest_valid_completion.assessment: A knowledgeable solver can give a concise complete proof. The new target has a real classification chain but is not claimed to be a long research problem.
shortest_valid_completion.short_counterexample_status: A lone localization counterexample no longer resolves the classification goals; it remains valid partial evidence.

proof_dependency_chain: Finite-free dual tensor-Hom isomorphism respects tower transitions.
Tensor commutes with the explicit filtered colimit.
Countability and torsion-freeness of M survive without injective transitions.
Representability implies the canonical countable-product comparison.
An enumeration in M^N plus one finite tensor expression forces finite generation.
Finite generation and torsion-freeness give finite freeness.
Duality produces the representing group and all-small-limit preservation.
Naturality from Z determines every component of every transformation.
optional_fully_proved_developments: Finite-stage retract criterion equivalent to the invariant criterion.
Constant projection tower refutes eventual-isomorphism necessity.
Multiplication-by-two baseline remains a nonrepresentable instance.
likely_illicit_strengthenings: Eventual equality becomes literal equality at the current stage.
Finite-rank at each stage becomes a uniform finite-rank bound or finite generation of the colimit.
The representing group is confused with the dual invariant or a pro-object.
formalization_effects: Any future formalization must cover the tensor identification, countability-based product test, representing-object classification, and natural transformation classification.
The optional finite-stage criterion is an additional proof target only if retained in the formal coverage claim.

public_sources.role: Filtered colimit equality and finite-limit background.
Countable product detects finite generation for countable modules.
